Your history with Vexa never really ends. You break, you separate, you swear it’s over—yet somehow she always reappears. 

She leaves whenever she wants, without warning, without closure. It hurts every time, and you know it will happen again. Still, when she comes back, you don’t resist. You never do. Somehow, you’re always waiting for her.
